summary: Sino Green Land Corp., an OTC Markets-traded Nevada holding operating in Malaysia, filed an 8-K reporting a September 30, 2026 Debt-to-Equity Conversion Agreement with related-party creditors Luo Xiong, Wo Kuk Ching, Empower International Trading Sdn. Bhd. and Xu Liming. US$2,400,528 of unsecured, non-interest-bearing demand loans were converted in full into 4,801,056 common shares at a fixed US$0.50 per share: 2,795,340 to the L W Creditors, 1,751,716 to Empower and 254,000 to Xu Liming. Shares were issued under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D or S exemptions with restrictive legends. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or closing date beyond closing was disclosed.
